Starting Amazon and overwhelmed by all the software out there?

Keep it simple.

For beginners, there are only two tools you really need:

✅ SellerAmp – to check profitability and competition
✅ Keepa – to understand a product's sales history

If you're building a Private Label brand, add:

✅ Helium 10 – for keyword and search data

Don't get distracted by dozens of subscriptions. Master the fundamentals first.

original_client_text.markup_text:
Stop guessing if a product will sell 👀📊

One of the tools Amazon sellers use to research products is Keepa.

It lets you look back at a product’s history price changes, sales-rank history, Buy Box activity and more so you’re not making a buying decision based only on what the product looks like TODAY.

Because a product can look amazing right now… but the historical data can tell a completely different story. 👀

🎓 Lesson 5/30 — Amazon FBA Academy Series

📦 Follow for Lesson 6, because next I’m showing you the other tool I use alongside Keepa before buying a product.

📞 Want help learning how to actually start selling on Amazon?

Book a FREE Amazon FBA call with me through the link in my bio.

We’ll talk about your goals, how to get started, and whether Amazon FBA is the right fit for you. 💻📦

If you’ve ever wondered how people make money flipping store finds on Amazon, here’s the process:

🔍 Step 1: Scan products – I use @SellerAmp to analyze products and see if they’re worth buying. I check the Amazon selling price, fees, competition, and sales history before making a decision.

🛒 Step 2: Buy profitable inventory – When the numbers make sense, I buy the products and bring them home to prep for Amazon.

📦 Step 3: Label & prep – Amazon has specific packaging and labeling requirements, so I make sure everything is prepped correctly before shipping it out.

🚀 Step 4: Ship to Amazon – I send the inventory to Amazon’s fulfillment centers, and they handle the storage, shipping, returns, and customer service. Once the products sell, the profits start rolling in.

📊 Step 5: Track profits with Seller Board – After my inventory is live, I use @sellerboard to monitor my numbers, track expenses, manage inventory, and see exactly how each product is performing.

Since getting started at 19 years old just 3 years ago, I’ve generated over $500k+ in Amazon sales and helped thousands of people learn how to source profitable products.

Head over to my youtube channel (link in bio) JASHUSTLES for my FREE step by step guides! #amazonfba #amazonseller

original_client_text.markup_text:
Selling products online can sound pretty complicated at first.

In reality, it takes a phone and a few tools. I run a $6M Amazon business from my laptop at home, without a warehouse, big team, and I never touch the products I'm selling.

1/ Smartscout helps me find products that are already listed, ranked, and selling thousands of times a month on Amazon.

2/ SellerAMP helps me check the exact profit margins when I'm selling the product, and gives me a maximum buy price on the product.

3/ KEEPA then helps me make sure the product has stable price history, so I can expect it to stay profitable all year round. (Extra layer of security)

4/ Then I can use ChatGPT to locate and find authorized U.S. suppliers near me to order the product inventory at wholesale

5/ Once Amazon approves me as a seller on Amazon, BQOOL runs an AI algorithm that's constantly adjusting my price to maximize the people buying from me.

Throughout the entire process, a warehouse packs and ships all the orders. Then Amazon handles all the shipping and customer service.

That's how I run my entire business and sell 20+ products from my laptop, in just 5-10 hours/week.
